subject: Security notification: request for IR plan, SIG/CAIQ clarifications and supporting artifacts
messages:
From: John Morales <john.morales@finsecure.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finsecure.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: brief auth anomaly — request for IRP & SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Hi Priyom,

We observed a small spike of failed auth retries in our sandbox integration this morning (approx 09:05 PDT). Nothing indicates customer data exfiltration but our security team has asked us to confirm your incident response posture and request documents for our internal review. Specifically, could you please provide:

- A current Incident Response Plan (IRP) PDF that covers notification timelines and escalation paths
- Completed SIG questionnaire (or answers to the 12 control items we flagged)
- Any recent SOC 2 sample logs or retention examples relevant to authentication/identity events

We appreciate a timeline for when we can expect these items — our Compliance review panel is meeting tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
John Morales
Sr. InfoSec Manager — FinSecure
john.morales@finsecure.com

Attachment: none
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: John Morales <john.morales@finsecure.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: brief auth anomaly — request for IRP & SIG/CAIQ artifacts

John — thanks for the heads up and for the specifics. We appreciate you flagging the spike. Quick confirmation: we are treating this as an information request rather than an incident escalation at this time.

What we'll provide by EOD today (packaged):
- Redwood_IR_Playbook_v2.pdf (full IRP; sections 2.1–2.4 cover notification SLAs and customer notification policy)
- SIG_Answers_20260831.xlsx (your 12 flagged control items + supporting notes)
- SOC2_sample_logs_2026-08-31.zip (redacted auth logs and retention notes)

One ask from our side: can you confirm whether your review requires redacted or fully-parsed logs (we will remove IPs/tenant IDs if you prefer a sanitized bundle). Also, do you need a CAIQ mapping in addition to the SIG answers? We can produce a short CAIQ crosswalk if helpful.

I'll loop in Marissa and Hannah for packaging and redaction. Expect the package and a short readme (what's included + recommended reviewers) by 16:30 PDT.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachment: none
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: package FinSecure request (IRP + SIG + SOC2 logs)

Team — John Morales at FinSecure asked for the IRP, SIG answers for 12 flagged items, and an example SOC 2 log bundle. Timeline: EOD 16:30 PDT. Priorities:

1) Marissa — please pull IR_Playbook_v2.pdf (latest from SharePoint) and confirm section numbering is stable; remove internal-only appendix A.
2) Hannah — handle log redaction: remove source IPs and full tenant UUIDs, keep timestamps and event codes; produce a README that explains redaction mapping and retention policy.
3) Karthik — spin up the SIG_Answers_20260831.xlsx by annotating the controls John flagged and add references to CAIQ where the mapping is direct. If time permits, include a 1-page CAIQ crosswalk.

Use the secure share link (SPS) for transfer; if FinSecure needs DocuSign acknowledgement for receipt, we'll route that separately. Copy me on all uploads.

Thanks — this is routine but they need the package for tomorrow's compliance panel.

— Priyom

Attachment: none
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: John Morales <john.morales@finsecure.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: IR playbook, SIG answers, and redacted SOC2 log samples

John — deliverables attached per your request. Summary below and transfer details.

What we attached:
- IR_Playbook_v2.pdf — our Incident Response Plan (public sections only; internal appendix removed). Section highlights:
  • Notification SLAs: 15m internal detect -> 1h cross-functional triage -> 24h customer notification threshold (if customer impact confirmed)
  • Escalation matrix with on-call pager rotation and enterprise incident owners
- SIG_Answers_20260831.xlsx — answers to the 12 items you flagged with references to controls and where evidence resides
- SOC2_sample_logs_2026-08-31.zip — sample auth logs redacted for IPs and tenant IDs; README inside explains redaction and retention windows

Transfer: secure link (expires in 7 days): https://redwood.securefiles.com/s/finsecure/20260831-pack (access audited; download requires SSO)

Notes and clarifications:
- We did not see any evidence of lateral movement or data exfiltration in the sample window you referenced.
- If you need the unredacted logs for a DFIR engagement, we'll require an executed NDA amendment and a time-limited SFTP access token (happy to coordinate).

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the sanitized bundle is sufficient for your compliance panel. If you want the CAIQ crosswalk, we can deliver that by tomorrow COB.

Best,
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachments (stubs): IR_Playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB), SIG_Answers_20260831.xlsx (XLSX, 220KB), SOC2_sample_logs_2026-08-31.zip (ZIP, 12MB)
